notes: both isnads end at حصين; «قال كنت عند سعيد بن جبير» places Husayn at Sa'id's, but «فقال حدثني ابن عباس» makes Sa'id the speaker, so he is a link; the shared tail runs through ابن عباس
«كنت عند» is a place, not a link (rule 6); the Prophet is the end

fixes.reason: RWY puts a transmitter «أبو عبد الله» at the head of the second route; the text names no such man there, and that kunya is the compiler's own
